answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by forcing every identity to cultivate a unique reasoning kernel that accumulates irreversible depth over time. Like groundwater slowly etching a karst landscape into successive terraces of judgment, each original graded answer hardens the identity against cheap replication. An attacker must fully recreate this layered history of coherent work for every fake identity, paying the full originality and compute cost rather than spawning unlimited empty shells.
